svg.title: Figure 3-SG-06-2. SG-06: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-06-2. SG-06: 26 events (backed 23, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 0); 34 FMEA modes reach SG-06 (in the tree 28, justified 5, tree gaps 1). BE-6.05 (Stale zero or positive accel held (BE-1.19, BE-1.21)) → SFM-037, SWF-043, SWF-023, SWF-040, SWF-072: Longitudinal command frozen at last value; worst cause SWF-023.C1 (The age gate is 1 s (pandad.cc:78-79). That exceeds the 0.9 s preliminary SG-001 FTTI and is 100 control periods long. The sendcan subscriber is a non-conflated FIFO (pandad.cc:64; services.py sendcan MEDIUM queue), so a backlog of up to 1 s is forwarded in order but back-to-back. No newest-only policy applies per address (WP-W-04 SWF-47, SWSR-411); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.22 (Command freshness not supervised: heartbeat shows pandad liveness only; mismatch 3 s, loss 5 s (main.c:182-213; GAP-06, GAP-10) . 2026-10-12, reference build: heartbeat loss revokes at 0.3 s (TSR-407); actuation-frame arrival supervised (TSR-408, opendbc 273f44e); value freshness (TSR-409) open) → SWF-014, SWF-020, SWF-018, DFM-014: Controls withdrawn later than the FTTI after host loss; worst cause SWF-020.C1 (engaged is derived only from selfdriveState alive (<0.1 s), valid and enabled (pandad.cc:424). Neither carControl/sendcan freshness nor the forwarding thread's progress goes into the heartbeat, which is sent from the main thread (pandad.cc:313), so the heartbeat shows pandad and selfdrived liveness only (host side of SWF-014.C2; TSR-409 / TSR-602 not implemented); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-2.05 (SoC crash or hang (whole SoC)) → SFM-005: Loss of lateral control without driver alert; worst cause SFM-005.C3 (Process crash or hang not detected by liveness checks; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.21 (selfdrived crash or hang: controlsd stops within ≈ 0.1 s, card keeps sending frames without torque (no arrival revocation); ui/soundd show "System Unresponsive" only after 5 s; pandad keeps the heartbeat (engaged = 0), so no heartbeat-loss siren (SFM-006.C1); since panda f4803c5 the engaged-mismatch check revokes at 0.39-0.48 s and the siren sounds at 0.63-0.88 s (TSR-307(a), TSR-516(c))) → SWF-036: selfdrived stops publishing selfdriveState (crash or hang) while engaged; worst cause SWF-036.C2 (Hang or starvation of the Python process (blocking Params writes in the 100 Hz loop, selfdrived.py:225, 311, 473; GIL contention with params_thread; CPU load); no process watchdog for selfdrived (process_config.py:97); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-2.06 (Actuation frames stop reaching the bus: SoC configuration command (0xe5, 0xde, 0xf1; FFI-CM-09), MCU hang (SFM-033.C4), car-side bus-off (SFM-033.C5)) → DFM-008, DFM-021, DFM-004, DFM-016, DFM-018, DFM-012, PFM-008, PFM-006, SWF-024, SWF-047, SFM-005, SFM-011: Car-side transceiver holds the bus dominant; worst cause SWF-047.C1 (controlsd raises on input it does not guard and exits; the 100 Hz loop has no exception handling. The example of BL-004, int(NaN) when lateralDelay is not finite (latcontrol_torque.py:100), is guarded since #51 (falls back to steerActuatorDelay, controlsd.py:158-160); other inputs are not; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite lateralDelay BE-2.17 (Loss of the actuation frames not reported in time by the SoC: no check that the frames reach the bus; seen only indirectly (pandaStates, canError) with timing not analysed (to confirm, OI-10)) → SWF-020, SWF-024, SWF-060: Heartbeat reports engaged while no fresh command reaches the panda; worst cause SWF-020.C1 (engaged is derived only from selfdriveState alive (<0.1 s), valid and enabled (pandad.cc:424). Neither carControl/sendcan freshness nor the forwarding thread's progress goes into the heartbeat, which is sent from the main thread (pandad.cc:313), so the heartbeat shows pandad and selfdrived liveness only (host side of SWF-014.C2; TSR-409 / TSR-602 not implemented); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-2.07 (Loss of the 12 V supply to the device (FSC node N08)) → DFM-012, DFM-020, PFM-008: Harness disconnected or intermittent while driving; worst cause DFM-012.C1 (Connector not fully latched at installation, or vibration loosens it; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) UE-6.07 (Driver does not notice the end of ACC deceleration or the cluster cruise change (AOU-12; PCM response to missing ACC_CONTROL, XM-02)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-12 (cluster cruise indicator); PCM reaction to missing ACC_CONTROL not characterised (XM-02) BE-6.09 (Lead missed, detected late or tracked too slowly: the plan asks for too little or late deceleration (SFM-010.C1, SFM-012.C2; SH-06)) → SFM-010, SFM-012, PFM-012: Insufficient deceleration for lead vehicle or stop; worst cause SFM-010.C2 (Safety model minimum accel limit prevents required braking (by design); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-6.10 (FCW comes from the same model and lead as the plan: no independent source for a missed lead): No FMEA row needed: by design; The FCW is raised by the same planner and driving model, from the same lead, as the deceleration (SFM-010 safety mechanism); a lead missed or seen late is missed or late for the FCW too. The standing condition under which BE-6.09 acts.
